sections.Profile:
The Caribbean Cruise pinball machine, released in 1989 by International Concepts, is a rare cocktail-style game with only 377 units produced. Designed by John Trudeau and featuring artwork by Constantino Mitchell, Jeanine Mitchell, and David Moore, this machine utilized the Gottlieb System 3 platform.

- Manufacturer: International Concepts
- Years made: 1989
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Travel, Cocktail, Solid State, 1980s
